description: Internal refurbishment of an existing two-storey flat located on 1st and 2nd floors including replacing existing staircase with a traditional design featuring timber balustrades; widening doorway between entrance hall and living room on 1st floor, returning to original design; reconfiguring 2nd floor to create two separate children's rooms and an improved primary bedroom; minor modifications to family bathroom on 2nd floor; replacing floor finishes with like-for-like materials and introducing heritage-style features, such as cornices, skirting boards, panelled doors, and architraves, on 2nd floor. No alterations to external building fabric.
